name: codex-optimizer
description: Automatically rewrite supported shell commands with RTK, compact tool output through Codex hooks, and keep coding responses concise.

interface.shortDescription: Automatic RTK rewrites and visible output compaction.
interface.longDescription: A hook-backed Codex optimizer for coding tasks. It automatically rewrites supported Bash commands through RTK, compacts tool output, reports every applied stage, and enables Caveman full and Ponytail full by default.
interface.defaultPrompt: Automatically apply Caveman full, Ponytail full, RTK command rewriting, and all safe output-compaction stages to this coding task.
